description: Regulatory decisions of one type across all Australian RTOs, newest first: registration cancellations (default), suspensions, conditions, rejected renewals, shortened registration, scope removed, or cancelled qualifications. Gives the totals (decisions, RTOs affected, overturned on review), then each decision with its date, status as recorded (e.g. In effect, Not yet in effect, Under review, On hold, Supported / Overturned on review), review stage, reference, and the RTO with its current registration status and links. Use it for questions like "which colleges had their registration cancelled recently". This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

excludeOverturned.description: Leave out decisions overturned, removed or set aside on review (the totals still count them).

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

since.description: Only decisions effective on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM).

type.description: cancellation (default), suspension (incl. part suspension), conditions, reject-renewal, shorten-registration, remove-scope, cancelled-qualifications (qualifications / statements of attainment the regulator cancelled).

name: get_rto_regulatory_actions
title: List regulatory actions against RTOs
